title: Create Your First Commit
description: A new repository needs to be initialized and its first project file committed so the team can start tracking the project.
objective: Initialize the repository, create README.md, and make the first Git commit.
hints: Start by initializing Git in the /workspace directory.
Create README.md, then use Git to stage the file and commit it.

intro.message: Hey! I was setting up this project and got pulled away before I could finish the repository setup. Can you get the project ready for version control?

success.message: Nice! The repository is initialized, README.md is tracked, and the first commit is in. We're ready to start building.

failure.message: We're not quite ready yet. Make sure README.md is actually committed and the repository is left in a clean final state.
